questions.question: God told the prophet Zechariah that He was very pleased with the fathers of the people. True or false?
Through the prophet Zechariah, what did the LORD of Hosts tell the people to do, and what would He do?

answers.text: They return to Him and He returns to them
They bring offerings and He forgives them
They rebuild His house and He blesses them

questions.question: When the earlier prophets told the people's fathers to turn from their evil ways, how did the fathers respond?
After God's words and statutes overtook the fathers of Zechariah's people, they repented. True or false?
